subject: english
question:
In the following question, the first and the last parts of the sentence/passage are numbered 1 and 6. The rest of the sentence/passage is split into four parts-P, Q, R, and S. These four parts are not given in their proper order. Read the sentence/passage and find the most logical order of the parts between 1 and 6.

Email has changed modern communication. P: It is faster than traditional letters. Q: Instant messaging is also gaining popularity. R: Emails allow file sharing and formal contact. S: However, they may lack personal touch. 6. Choosing the right medium depends on context.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence begins by establishing how email has transformed modern communication.
 
• **Sentence P comes first** as it highlights the speed advantage of emails:
 
 
• "It is faster than traditional letters."
 
 
 
• **Sentence R follows** as it elaborates on the functional benefits of emails:
 
 
• "Emails allow file sharing and formal contact."
 
 
 
• **Sentence S comes next** as it acknowledges a drawback of emails:
 
 
• "However, they may lack personal touch."
 
 
 
• **Sentence Q is the last** as it transitions to another popular form of communication, instant messaging:
 
 
• "Instant messaging is also gaining popularity."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **PRSQ**.

 

**Coherent passage after rearrangement**:

"Email has changed modern communication. It is faster than traditional letters. Emails allow file sharing and formal contact. However, they may lack personal touch. Instant messaging is also gaining popularity. Choosing the right medium depends on context."
